task: Automatically preprocess retained browser HTML and store an integrity-checked cleaned R2 artifact before AI review, preserving original data and all limits. Use Terra implementation and independent review, open an unmerged PR only.
nonGoals: No production or temporary Cloudflare deployment, remote schema/resource/data changes, live model/browser calls, frontend or shared dependency changes.
No changes to 60% included allowance ceilings,1000ms CPU cap, admission/settlement rules, authentication, rubric weights, AI deadlines or unrelated services.
No automatic site-specific attribute list, silent truncation, deletion of original capture, extension of24-hour retention or claim cleaned HTML proves visibility/exhaustive absence.

outcomes.description: A deterministic bounded native HTMLRewriter cleaner removes non-JSON scripts, styles/comments/presentation attributes and SVG geometry while preserving semantic text, headings, JSON-LD/embedded JSON, tables, links, form values, accessibility labels/descriptions and references. Limits fail explicitly; no text-block count cap determines cleaned-source completeness.
outcomes.evidence: Frozen semantic/geometry/script/hostile/size/UTF8 preservation fixtures and local native runtime replay; source/output hashes and reduction measurements.

outcomes.description: Original HTML/snapshot stay immutable in R2. A versioned cleaned artifact with source reference/hash,output hash/size and original expiry is persisted and read back with existing R2 admission before assessment. Prepared publication is atomic/fail-closed, retries/concurrency cannot mix artifacts, and cleanup removes prepared objects.
outcomes.evidence: Real SQLite/fake-R2 integration tests for save/read/tampering/partial writes/expiry/budget denial/concurrency and workflow restart from stored prepared artifact.

outcomes.description: The browser-content assessment path derives retained inputs from the persisted cleaned artifact and supplies PR47 verified preprocessing metadata; initial-response evidence remains unavailable, parser completeness stays diagnostic, and no AI runs before required durable artifacts verify.
outcomes.evidence: Service/workflow/source integration regressions, version/cache identity regression, existing rubric/report regressions.

process.description: Commit this valid named-command plan before implementation, use isolated codex branch, Terra agents with disjoint file ownership, real source-bound evaluation/handoff/exit test and independent review, then open PR and check hosted CI. Do not merge/deploy.
process.evidence: Git history,review/exit evidence,run/trace/handoff and GitHub PR/CI.

styleEfficiency.description: Reuse installed native parser, snapshot store, R2 allowance guards and browser workflow. Keep one cleaned artifact rather than a new orchestration subsystem, reuse prepared data on retries and keep merchant captures private.
styleEfficiency.evidence: Diff and operation-order/reuse tests, private Faherty local replay, no new dependencies/services.

exitTest.reason: Prepared R2 persistence changes the resumable boundary. Export frozen synthetic capture/index/prepared artifact after storage and have a fresh agent with only export and clean task files resume assessment-input preparation, proving it does not rerun preprocessing and still rejects tampered/expired artifacts.

context: Base is unmerged PR47 (e18d2a7) for direct cleaned-HTML AI review; this PR will be stacked on that branch until integration.
